message.content: {"id": "i2", "meaning_zh": "珠江是广州的核心河流，此刻在暮色下泛着暖橙波光，游船与城市灯火在水面交织出浪漫的都会夜曲。", "examples": [{"en": "From the high-floor restaurant by the floor-to-ceiling window, the Pearl River glows with the golden reflection of the sunset, while cruise boats glide gently over its rippling surface.", "zh": "在高空落地窗餐厅里向外眺望，珠江水面映着落日的金橙余晖，游船正缓缓划过柔波。"}, {"en": "On crisp autumn evenings, I love taking a slow walk along the Pearl River with friends, stopping occasionally to grab a cup of milk tea and watch the city lights turn on one by one.", "zh": "在凉爽的秋夜，我喜欢和朋友沿着珠江慢慢散步，偶尔停下来买杯奶茶，看着城市灯火一盏盏亮起。"}], "usage_note_zh": "提到珠江夜景、河畔散步或游船体验时，可以自然使用这个表达；日常聊到国内旅行目的地时，也可以用它指代广州的核心河流景观。"}

parsed_json.meaning_zh: 珠江是广州的核心河流，此刻在暮色下泛着暖橙波光，游船与城市灯火在水面交织出浪漫的都会夜曲。

examples.en: From the high-floor restaurant by the floor-to-ceiling window, the Pearl River glows with the golden reflection of the sunset, while cruise boats glide gently over its rippling surface.
examples.zh: 在高空落地窗餐厅里向外眺望，珠江水面映着落日的金橙余晖，游船正缓缓划过柔波。

examples.en: On crisp autumn evenings, I love taking a slow walk along the Pearl River with friends, stopping occasionally to grab a cup of milk tea and watch the city lights turn on one by one.
examples.zh: 在凉爽的秋夜，我喜欢和朋友沿着珠江慢慢散步，偶尔停下来买杯奶茶，看着城市灯火一盏盏亮起。
